tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Primary. Dark grounds (topbar, hero, 'Good to know' band, footer), primary buttons, body text on light grounds.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Primary. Secondary buttons, selected states in the booking panel, photo placeholders. Use sparingly: it was overused in early drafts.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Off-white / brand grey. The page ground, cards on maroon, text on maroon.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Accent. Text on periwinkle and chartreuse-on-forest pairings; 'done' ticks; numbered circles on periwinkle.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Accent. Button hover, notification badges, tags. Maroon text only.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Accent. The quote card, tags. Maroon text only. Not a primary colour.

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Accent. Section band ('You'll walk away with'), tags, the footer's bottom band. Forest text.

tokens.name: chartreuse
tokens.usage: Accent. Numbers in circles, tags, the sticker-photo backing, social circles. Maroon text only.

tokens.name: maroon-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary buttons.

tokens.name: maroon-soft
tokens.usage: Hover on maroon grounds, date-picker borders.

tokens.name: lavender-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: lavender-soft
tokens.usage: Lavender tint.

tokens.name: grey-100
tokens.usage: Warm grey: borders, hairlines on cream.

tokens.name: grey-300
tokens.usage: Warm grey: disabled borders.

tokens.name: grey-600
tokens.usage: Warm grey: muted text on cream (7:1).

tokens.name: grey-800
tokens.usage: Warm grey resolving into maroon.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors only. Never for 'not taking bookings yet' (that is body text).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text on light grounds.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page ground.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rules and card borders on cream.

tokens.name: hairline-on-dark
tokens.usage: 1px rules on maroon.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals and the phone booking sheet.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Get clear on your next career move, then make it.
styles.usage: Page H1 (session title). Regular weight; the phrase after the last comma in Bold 700. 38px on phone.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headings. Regular + one bold word or phrase, ending with a full stop. 30px on phone.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: You're good at your job. You're less sure it's the right job.
styles.usage: The first sentence of a description. 24px on phone.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “I'll say the thing your friends are too polite to say.”
styles.usage: Quote card text, bold ending. 19px on phone.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Coach name, panel heading ('Book with Maya').

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The total in the booking panel. 34px in the phone sheet.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: CAREER COACH FOR WOMEN STEPPING INTO LEADERSHIP
styles.usage: One-line subtitle under a headline or name. ALL CAPS, off-white on maroon or maroon on cream. Never pink.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section label followed by a hairline rule. ALL CAPS.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and topbar nav. ALL CAPS.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: We'll separate what you want from what you think you should want.

styles.name: body

styles.usage: Default body. Bio Sans has only 400 and 700.

styles.name: body-s
